propositions: Six concurrent job slots (5 per-extra + 1 union) in _optionality.yml fan out redundantly, consuming critical GitHub Free org slots and causing 6.7-8.4m queue delays under burst load.
The per-extra matrix does not match _optional.EXTRAS: mcp is tested but not in EXTRAS; metrics is in EXTRAS but has no per-extra CI today.

Collapsing to a single venv-loop job must maintain isolation (each extra in its own venv, never stacking activations), run joint dependency resolution in the union iteration, and fail-fast with explicit rc accumulation.

Union iteration validates joint installation of agents+eval+tracing into one venv; isolation iterations must each run import rebar and _optional.extra_installed() probes, plus rebar-mcp --help for mcp only.
Loop must use absolute venv paths (never bare console-script names) and contain no activate sourcing to prevent silent re-tests of the wrong interpreter.

Checked-in tests must guard loop shape (rc accumulator with continue and exit), verify all _optional.EXTRAS keys are covered, and infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json must drop obsolete check names.
